ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Hinode SOT-FG Level 0 Shutterless Stokes I and V FITS Data (FGSIV)

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: The Hinode Solar Optical Telescope Filtergraph (SOT-FG) Level 0 FGSIV FITS data product contains uncalibrated Stokes I and Stokes V images acquired with the Narrowband Filter Imager (NFI) in shutterless observing mode. The product is identified by DataCode FGSIV and OBS_TYPE='FG shutterless I and V', distinguishing it from the shuttered FGIV product. The FITS Primary HDU contains a three-dimensional image array with two image planes representing Stokes I and V. Shutterless readout provides rapid polarimetric imaging over a restricted field of view; image dimensions vary with observation settings. The inspected Level 0 FITS headers identify the shutterless observing mode with FGMODE='shutterless' and GEN_ID=32. The observing spectral line and wavelength offset are identified by the FITS keywords WAVE and WAVEOFF, respectively. The Level 0 images precede ground-based scientific calibration.

Parameter.Name: Shutterless Stokes I and V Images
Parameter.Description: Three-dimensional Level 0 SOT-FG shutterless Stokes I and V image data stored in the FITS Primary HDU. The first two array dimensions represent spatial image coordinates, and the third dimension contains two image planes corresponding to Stokes I and Stokes V. The field of view is restricted in shutterless mode. Images are acquired in selected discrete NFI spectral-line passbands rather than across a continuous wavelength range; the selected line and wavelength offset are given by FITS keywords WAVE and WAVEOFF. The arrays have not undergone ground-based scientific calibration.
